subject: Reference format
notes: kb/Work PB1361 (w70b): '1) If the line is a SOURCE FORMAT directive, the reference format mode is determined and the SOURCE FORMAT directive line is logically discarded.' (cite.py --check 6.5 -> OK §6.5 1)). The mode is now STATE of an in-order walk over the lines, and a directive line is recognized against the program-text area of the mode in effect: a free-form '>>SOURCE FORMAT FIXED' whose operand lies past column 72 switches the mode (the golden's line 13 starts it at column 75), where the format-blind margin-R cut used to truncate it to '>>SOURCE FORMA' (COBOL1911) and leave the mode unchanged. The directive line is discarded to an empty slot as before.
